query: Which recurrence-plot parameter selection strategy (AMI, FNN, fixed defaults) plus fallback rules best balance detection accuracy and O(N^2) cost for real‑time deployment?

response.query: Which recurrence-plot parameter selection strategy (AMI, FNN, fixed defaults) plus fallback rules best balance detection accuracy and O(N^2) cost for real‑time deployment?
response.answer: Fixed defaults with AMI parameter selection and fallback rules balance accuracy and O(N^2) cost for real-time deployment. AMI optimizes detection while minimizing computational overhead. Fallback rules ensure reliability when defaults are insufficient.
